arguments.sql:
SELECT typeof(u.CreationDate) AS storage_type,
       length(u.CreationDate) AS timestamp_length,
       COUNT(*) AS matching_count,
       MIN(u.CreationDate) AS earliest,
       MAX(u.CreationDate) AS latest
FROM main.users AS u
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Michael'
GROUP BY 1, 2;
